== Build notes ==

Guest stub. DecipherCon 1999 hosted the Star Trek CCG World Championship as well as SWCCG Worlds. Eisenberg signed as Nog. He is not listed as a Star Wars CCG player.

== Build notes (25 October 2026) ==
* Lead photo: [[:File:Aron Eisenberg DecipherCon 1999.jpg]], crop of Decipher photo sat62, whose caption names Eisenberg alone. Second crop: [[:File:Aron Eisenberg DecipherCon 1999 fri30.jpg]] from the original fri30 frame.
* Decipher captions naming him: FRI fri29, fri30, fri31; SAT sat52, sat53, sat62, sat69 (all 179 archived photo pages checked). Only sat62 and fri30 have archived large images; the others survive only as 50 × 38 thumbnails.
* Missing data: no wiki page for Tournament Director Barbie Buchanan (fri31) or Chase Masterson; left unlinked.
* The guests page lists the signing times without day labels in its text; the day-by-day account follows Lalumiere's Day 2 and Day 3 wrap-ups. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 02:03, 26 October 2026 (UTC)
